item.title: HelloTrade: $4.6 Million Seed Funding Raised To Expand Global Access To Leveraged Equity Trading
item.description: HelloTrade, a blockchain-powered trading platform founded by former BlackRock crypto directors Wyatt Raich and Kevin Tang, has secured a $4.6 million seed round led by Dragonfly Capital. According to the company, the round was completed in under one week, a pace the founders attribute to strong investor confidence in the global market opportunity and their experience building large-scale digital asset products. item.title: Lantern: Interview With President Dickon Waterfield About The Specialty Care Platform
item.description: Lantern is a Specialty Care Platform that helps employers reduce their specialty care spending and improve outcomes by directing employees to the highest-quality surgeons and infusion and cancer care via their Network of Excellence.. Pulse 2.0 interviewed Lantern President Dickon Waterfield to gain a deeper understanding of the company.

item.title: bQuest: Seed Investment Raised For Advancing AI-Powered Care Intelligence Platform
item.description: First Rate Ventures has led a seed investment in Denver-based bQuest, a Care Intelligence Platform designed to help financial advisors support clients through aging, end-of-life, and after-loss transitions. The companies announced the fundraising and strategic partnership on Thursday, outlining plans to integrate bQuest’s AI Care Agents directly into advisor workflows.

item.title: Aramco Announces Over $30 Billion In New US Agreements, Totaling $90 Billion
item.description: Aramco announced 17 new Memoranda of Understanding and agreements with major US companies, totaling a potential value exceeding $30 billion. The announcement builds on the 34 agreements disclosed in May, which were estimated to be worth approximately $90 billion. Combined, Aramco’s efforts signal collaboration opportunities with US partners valued at around $120 billion.

item.title: BCN: Interview With Chairman Richard Boudria About The Managed Network And Technology Solutions Company
item.description: BCN is a leading provider of managed network and technology solutions.. Pulse 2.0 interviewed BCN Chairman and CEO Richard M. Boudria to gain a deeper understanding of the firm.

item.title: MAULOA: Interview With Founding Partner Andrew Sachs About The Investment Firm
item.description: MAULOA is a firm of long-term investors that provides owner liquidity and working capital to family-owned businesses to accelerate growth. Pulse 2.0 interviewed MAULOA founding partner Andrew Sachs to gain a deeper understanding of the firm.

item.title: Pibit.AI: $7 Million Series A Raised To Advance Development Of Its AI-Powered Underwriting Platform
item.description: Pibit.AI has raised a $7 million Series A round as the San Francisco-based insurtech company seeks to modernize underwriting through its trusted AI platform, CURE. The investment, led by Stellaris Venture Partners with participation from Y Combinator and Arali Ventures, will help the company advance its centralized underwriting system and broaden adoption across carriers and MGAs.

item.title: Vouched: Interview With CEO Peter Horadan About The Identity Verification Company
item.description: Vouched is a company that provides AI-based identity verification and fraud prevention solutions. Pulse 2.0 interviewed Vouched CEO Peter Horadan to gain a better understanding of the company.

item.title: Redpanda: Jennifer Lawrence Named As Chief Revenue Officer
item.description: Redpanda has appointed Jennifer Lawrence as its new Chief Revenue Officer, as the company continues to expand following a $100 million Series D financing round earlier this year and the acquisition of Oxla. The company said Lawrence will lead all global revenue functions, including go-to-market strategy, customer engagement, and revenue operations as adoption of real-time data infrastructure accelerates across enterprises.

item.title: Vantage Data Centers: $1.6 Billion Investment Secured And Acquisition Of Yondr’s Johor Hyperscale Campus Finalized
item.description: Vantage Data Centers has completed a $1.6 billion equity investment into its Asia-Pacific platform, solidifying the company’s position as one of the region’s largest and fastest-growing digital infrastructure providers.
